blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 101 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (October 23, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: DCBO & MRNA lead 101 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 34 Canadian and 67 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of October 23, 2026) found 101 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 34 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 19 of them new to the list this week. Docebo Inc. (DCBO) leads with a +71% six-month return, and Energy is the most represented sector with 15 names.

In the U.S., 67 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 31 of them new to the list this week. Moderna Inc. (MRNA) leads with a +323% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 24 names.
